name: Sparrow Seal
tagline: Every gram accounted for. Every regulator charmed.
positioning: Sparrow Seal turns cannabis compliance from a filing nightmare into a single luminous dashboard for growers, budtenders, and solo operators.

hero.h1: Compliance that flies. Regulators that smile.
hero.sub: Sparrow Seal watches your seed-to-sale trail, catches manifest gaps before the state does, and turns your METRC chaos into one calm, glowing feed you actually understand.

features.title: Manifest guardian
features.description: We scan every transfer manifest against state rules the moment you draft it, flagging weight mismatches and missing labels before a single package leaves the door.

features.title: METRC reconciliation
features.description: Your on-hand counts and METRC tags fall out of sync constantly. Sparrow Seal reconciles them nightly and hands you the exact discrepancies to fix.

features.title: Audit-ready binder
features.description: One tap generates a timestamped compliance binder — COAs, manifests, waste logs — formatted for your state inspector, not for a lawyer to translate.

features.title: Deadline radar
features.description: License renewals, tax filings, and reporting windows tracked to the day, with nudges early enough to actually act on them.

features.title: Waste witness
features.description: Log destruction events with photos, weights, and the mandated cure period, so your quarantine and disposal records survive any surprise visit.

features.title: Multi-state map
features.description: Operate across state lines? See each jurisdiction's rulebook side by side and stop guessing which THC limit applies where.

testimonials.quote: We were three failed reconciliations from a suspension. Sparrow Seal caught the phantom tags our old spreadsheet buried and rebuilt our whole binder in an afternoon. The inspector actually complimented us.
testimonials.name: Dana Whitlock

testimonials.quote: I run a two-person craft grow. I don't have a compliance department — I have Sparrow Seal. It flags my manifest errors before I hit submit, and I sleep again.
testimonials.name: Marcus Ferreira

testimonials.quote: Renewal season used to swallow a full week. Now the deadline radar pings me, the binder is already built, and I file in twenty minutes. It feels almost unfair.
testimonials.name: Priya Anand

pricing.blurb: For single-license growers and boutique operators keeping their own books.
For busy dispensaries and multi-room grows that can't afford a slip.
For multi-state operators managing rulebooks across jurisdictions.

homepage.footerBlurb: Sparrow Seal keeps cannabis operators audit-ready, one luminous dashboard at a time. Not legal advice — just fewer sleepless filing nights.
